title: Calendar Query Pattern
description: Schema for calendar meeting query patterns in CSV format

PatternId.description: Unique identifier for the query pattern

query_pattern.description: The query pattern template with placeholders for dynamic values (e.g., <subject_1>, <body>, <timeSpan>)

segment_1.description: Primary category or classification of the query pattern

segment_2.description: Secondary category or subcategory of the query pattern
